method: Independent read-only inspection of exact criteria, current source bodies, local role-permission definitions, applied test bodies and reports, sealed evidence hashes, plus two rendered screenshots. No browser/build executions, product/backend edits, acceptance ledger mutation or live account operations.
perspectives: truthful action feedback and role semantics
privacy/security of visible and copied diagnostics

187.requirement: Give login-account management clear role descriptions and pending/error feedback without implying frontend visibility enforces authorization.
pass_conditions: Account management explains each available role and shows truthful pending, success and persistent failure feedback.
Role visibility does not claim to enforce authorization; server refusal remains visible and leaves account state unchanged.
evidence_needed: Role-based account interaction traces, delayed failures and server read-back.
Evidence must identify the relevant source/build and the covered fixture, role, state and environment; retain untested portions explicitly.

189.requirement: Improve diagnostics readability with a short service summary and expandable technical information that avoids unnecessary personal data.
pass_conditions: Diagnostics first exposes a concise service summary and keeps detailed technical output in expandable sections.
Default and expanded diagnostics avoid unnecessary member data, credentials and pairing secrets in visible or copied output.
evidence_needed: Summary/detail visual review and diagnostic redaction inspection.
Evidence must identify the relevant source/build and the covered fixture, role, state and environment; retain untested portions explicitly.

190.requirement: Make unavailable diagnostics recoverable without turning unrelated operational screens into error pages or blank placeholders.
pass_conditions: Unavailable diagnostics leaves unrelated operational navigation and loaded content usable.
The diagnostics surface explains failure and exposes a working retry or supported alternative without replacing the whole application with an error.
evidence_needed: Diagnostics outage, retry and unrelated-screen interaction traces.
Evidence must identify the relevant source/build and the covered fixture, role, state and environment; retain untested portions explicitly.

current_applicability: Relevant main/API/projection/CSS and all other sealed source files match. Only recycle-bin.ts differs in both historical seals. This is a scoped applicability assessment for unchanged account/diagnostics handlers, not a new full-source build certification or blind hash refresh. Recycle-bin current change needs its own review.

187.reason: The three available computer-admin roles and fourth superadmin-only role have explicit descriptions agreeing with local ROLE_PERMISSIONS. Pending account creation and recovery are persistent text/status nodes; create refusal retains original fields and uses an alert rather than asserting rollback; confirmed creation is distinct from subsequent list-refresh failure. Applied 24 contexts span Chromium/Firefox/WebKit, 320/1280, light/dark, both admin operator roles; exact submitted body and one pending create POST are asserted.

187.assessment: supported for frontend behavior; live server authorization unverified
187.reason: Visible guide explicitly assigns authorization checks to server. The 403 fixture reaches actual request transport and persistent UI refusal; fixture account state stays unchanged. Explicit read retry adds GET without repeating POST. Test success uses fixture read-back; it cannot prove actual backend permission enforcement or durable state. Recovery token is shown only in native prompt, excluded from persistent status; late sign-out suppresses prompt/status.

189.reason: Current source places operational counts and a clear non-certification statement first; rules/count-only explanation, sanitized JSON and build details are native expandable disclosures. Independently viewed 320-light applied screenshot: five titled groups, meaningful counts including zero, collapsible support detail and no visible private labels. Keyboard disclosure and scoped axe assertions passed in 12 contexts; no blanket WCAG claim.

shareableDiagnostics constructs a new allowlisted projection rather than serializing response. Private category names are anonymized; numeric amounts retained, missing/nonfinite values null, rule text excluded, timestamp syntax/calendar checked. HTML uses escaping. Tests independently specify literal expected JSON and assert exact DOM, copied and fallback-selected output; injected credentials, pairing/member/email/rule labels are absent. Copy current-owner guards suppress stale feedback/focus after route/profile/sign-out changes; pending repeat Enter sends one synthetic clipboard call. Original connected copy button is released even after profile replaces operator object.

190.assessment: supported for Accounts operational navigation fixture
190.reason: Both resolved 503 and 200 diagnostics requests arriving after real desktop/mobile navigation to Accounts preserve URL, username/password drafts and focus. renderTicket gates late paints by view/render generation; full app is not replaced. Twelve current-source contexts cover three engines, two widths and themes. Other operational screens and production failures are not inferred from this one tested destination.

Visible failure displays fixed safe persistent alert, hides private server detail and exposes explicit Try again. Retry issues one additional held GET, then produces the normal summary; subsequent Accounts navigation remains usable. Test denies unexpected requests and every mutation; reported isolation contexts all passed.

nonblocking_followups: The diagnostics role allowlist does not name hod, so HOD counts are retained under anonymous additional_role. This loses useful role context but does not expose private data; keep a separate semantics-reviewed followup.
Account create errors display escaped server message by existing transport contract; evidence proves the supplied refusal, not absence of sensitive content in every possible server error.

Account recovery pending release depends on unchanged operator identity; a same-account profile update during recovery is not covered by account187 applied trace. Diagnostics copy specifically covers and releases this case.

Native fixed mobile navigation intersects full-page screenshot positions; this screenshot alone does not certify every scroll/focus occlusion condition. Applied viewport interactions and overflow tests are narrower evidence.
limitations: No live server authorization, persistence, actual account state read-back or production data used. Fixture refusal cannot demonstrate security enforcement.
No native OS clipboard, physical device, native assistive technology, full contrast or actual 200 percent text certification.
Account188 activation/role-change supported-capability analysis is separate; these tests do not invent missing endpoints.
Context-help193 stage is not applied and is outside this review.
Original account harness finalizer and diagnostic first-run fixture-path failures remain in immutable seals; no failures erased.
No acceptance mutation: root must combine this scoped review with other required perspectives and applicable current build evidence.
recommendation: Scoped frontend behavior is supported for 187,189,190 with the explicit fixture and current-source boundaries above. Do not interpret as full repository/current build acceptance or backend security certification.
